hook: LlamaIndex releases OCRia-nano-1, an 8.1M-parameter open-weight OCR model
hookText: LlamaIndex releases OCRia-nano-1, an 8.1M-parameter open-weight OCR model

beats.say: OCRia-nano-1 bundles seven tiny document models into LiteParse and parses a page in about 426 ms on one CPU core, with no GPU, and LlamaIndex says it beats Marker, PP-OCRv6 tiny and Tesseract on tables and layout.
LlamaIndex reports 59.2 overall on its ParseBench-2 benchmark and 27.8 pages per second with 16 single-core workers, about twice the throughput of LiteParse's default Tesseract setup.
The weights use a modified Open RAIL-M license; LiteParse itself is Apache 2.0.
